description: Control a relay output state. Use "state" to set a specific state (on/off), or omit to toggle. When state is "on", you can optionally provide "pulseDuration" to auto-turn off after the specified milliseconds.

requestBody.name: state
requestBody.description: Desired output state. If omitted, toggles the current state.

requestBody.name: pulseDuration
requestBody.description: Auto-off duration in milliseconds (only applies when state is "on"). If greater than 0, the output auto-turns off after the specified duration.

local.python:
import http.client
import json


conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("192.168.0.1")
payload = json.dumps({
  "state": "on",
  "pulseDuration": 0
})
headers = {
  'Accept': 'application/json',
  'X-API-Key': '<X-API-Key>',
  'Content-Type': 'application/json'
}
conn.request("POST", "/proxy/protect/integration/v1/relays/{id}/outputs/{outputId}/activate", payload, headers)
res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()
print(data.decode("utf-8"))
local.ansible:
- name: Activate relay output
  ubiquiti.unifi_api.protect:
    path: "/v1/relays/{id}/outputs/{outputId}/activate"
    method: POST
    body:
      state: 'on'
      pulseDuration: 0
  register: result


- debug:
    var: result.data
